test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL 2022 - English (Held On: 01 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word ‘SINKS’ from the given sentence.

Groups work together to create Christmas parade themes, which are then carried out in floats, musical groups, and strolling figures.
solution: The correct answer is** floats**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Sink: **to go down or make something go down under the surface of liquid or a soft substance. डूबना या (किसी वस्‍तु को) डुबोना (तरल या कोमल पदार्थ में) • **Float:** to move slowly through air or water. हवा या पानी में तिरना, बहना, उतराना • Thus, the most appropriate antonym of the given word is **option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Create: **to cause something new to happen or exist. कुछ नया उत्‍पन्‍न, रचना, बनाना • **Parade:** an occasion when a group of people stand or walk in a line so that people can look at them. परेड, क़वायद, जुलूस • **Strolling:** to walk in a slow relaxed way, especially for pleasure. चहलक़दमी या सैर करना, टहलना 33:T443, The correct answer is **equal**.
